versions.content: To serialize the request message of UDS Service WriteDataByI- dentifier request into the required AUTOSAR data types (signed- and unsigned inte- ger), the target endianness configured in DcmDspDataEndianness shall be consid- ered for DcmDspData elements having DcmDspDataUsePort set to USE_DATA_- SENDER_RECEIVER , USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER_AS_SERVICE . In case DcmD- spDataEndianness is not present, the DcmDspDataDefaultEndianness shall be used instead.
